protected_invariants.heading: Purpose
protected_invariants.text: Gets the weekly Delivery Checkpoint (the meeting title and org come from settings) ready each week. It builds that date's tab in the Delivery Excellence doc, runs a read-only audit, checks the feature cards for the configured groups, and leaves draft comments for the leader to review. It posts nothing.

protected_invariants.text: 2. If there is no copy, onboard: ask for the leader's name, org name, checkpoint meeting title, Jira site and filter id, goals root, features sheet, the groups with their owners, and the feature card group ids and releases. Offer to find what can be found (calendar for the meeting title, the doc if one is already shared). Ask only for what cannot be found; never ask the leader to recall a document name or id.

protected_invariants.heading: Onboarding and Settings
protected_invariants.text: Jira access uses `JIRA_EMAIL` and `JIRA_TOKEN` in `~/.secrets.env`. If a token is needed, tell the person exactly what to create and where, and have them put it in the file themselves. Never ask them to paste it in chat.

protected_invariants.heading: Tool Boundaries
protected_invariants.text: Read-only everywhere except the new tab on the Delivery Excellence doc and files under `out/<date>/` in the skill's resources folder. It never posts, resolves, or edits comments, never sends messages or email, never writes to Jira, and never edits Appian Home feature cards. These are the RULES stated in the contract above.
